question.prompt: Point A is rotated clockwise through \(90^\circ\) about O to obtain A′. What is the relationship between OA and OA′?

solutions.explanation: Under a rotation, corresponding points are at equal distances from the center of rotation, so \(OA=OA'\). The angle between the segments joining corresponding points to the center equals the angle of rotation, so \(\angle AOA'=90^\circ\).
solutions.title: Apply the properties of rotation
